records.title: Logical positions and origin epochs
inputs: Versioned cell width/axis convention
Logical cell and normalized local offsets
Current origin epoch and proposed render-origin delta
records.authority: World authority for position; client for render origin
invariants: Editorial map coordinates never become meters by inference
Stable entity IDs never contain transient origin or instance slot
Source ability semantics remain unchanged
acceptance_tests: Round-trip negative and positive boundary positions exactly within chosen numeric precision
Rebase during moving mount, trail, projectile, water and portal transition; no divergent collision or dangling old-epoch query
Run source-adapter comparison before/after rebase with tolerances reviewed for selected engine
failure_cases: Source effect retains stale world-space coordinate

records.title: Terrain and watershed construction
inputs: Generator version and seed
Approved measured masks and overrides
Shared sample grid and neighbor edge data
invariants: Physical geography precedes Oath-specific dressing
Four baseline basins and 30 land adjacencies preserved
Generation does not approve canon
acceptance_tests: Generate neighbors in reverse order and compare common edge samples/normals
Check downhill channel sequence and mapped karst reemergence
Walk baseline sample route and refuge through all LOD/collision states
failure_cases: Generator upgrade changes saved ground without migration

records.title: Streaming readiness and resource leases
inputs: Cell key, bundle revision and request generation
Travel envelope and destination intent
Available memory/IO budget
outputs: Ready stage and permitted entry anchor
records.authority: Client residency manager; authority entry eligibility
invariants: Gameplay-ready requires collision/nav/state/mandatory cues
Late completion cannot resurrect retired generation
Shared resources disposed only after final lease
acceptance_tests: Inject slow load beyond predicted mount arrival; legal stop with safe collision
Oscillate across border; no uncontrolled request churn or duplicate entity
Unload one of two resource-sharing cells; other remains intact
Fail fine art while coarse gameplay remains safe
failure_cases: Double release, stale promise completion or mixed content revisions

records.title: Visibility, LOD and environmental quality
inputs: Quality tier, camera and conservative bounds
Semantic hazard/service cues
Seeded weather category and environmental material state
invariants: Occlusion/LOD never changes authoritative collision or damage
Instanced slot is not gameplay identity
Same hazard semantics across quality tiers
acceptance_tests: Turn camera quickly and open doors under fog/night; critical cues remain
Reuse instance slots after harvesting; same stable entity IDs resolve
Measure vegetation, shadows, transparency and water on nominated devices
Inspect fifteen regional silhouettes without palette-only recognition
failure_cases: Water art disagrees with swim volume

records.title: Interior portals and protected exits
inputs: Stable portal/space ID and permissions
Exterior/interior bundle revision
Pinned fallback public anchor
invariants: Private permissions are checked by authority
Exterior eviction cannot remove legal exit
One actor owner throughout transition
acceptance_tests: Disconnect in interior then reconnect after exterior revision changes
Revoke entry permission during preload without trapping actor
Rapid doorway reversals release abandoned loads without duplicate actor
failure_cases: Interior art ready before safe entry state

records.title: Population leases and actor clearance
inputs: Stable actor/spawn IDs and aggregate habitat state
Nav revision, clearance profile and schedule
Current authority tick and region event state
invariants: Named/service NPCs retain identity and fallback location
No reward-bearing actor duplicated on unload/reload
Ordinary foot/pack access never depends on special Oath traversal
acceptance_tests: Unload/reload same caravan from two clients; one owner and no duplicate yield
Large mount rejects too-small door and provides legal dismount
Event reroute preserves service NPC reachability with no nav deadlock
Bounded aggregate catch-up cannot mint offline rewards
failure_cases: Schedule places service NPC beyond accessible route

records.title: Authored destruction and reconstruction
inputs: Whitelisted state transition and expected revision
Prepared collision/nav/mesh bundle
Verified service detour and contribution receipt
outputs: Single committed state revision or refusal
invariants: No arbitrary terrain deformation promised
Protected housing/service access survives every state
Visual debris cannot create new reward ownership
acceptance_tests: Fail nav build before commit; old safe state retained
Crash before/after reward and stage commit; no duplicated goods
No-player event reaches safe reconstruction without permanent route loss
failure_cases: Reward replay or unrecoverable service closure

records.title: Authority interest and cross-cell replication
inputs: Accepted event sequence and authority epoch
Client acknowledgements and interest set
Content version and semantic position error budget
records.authority: Single simulation authority until tested handover
invariants: Clients send intents rather than declare damage
Cell visibility does not determine entity persistence
Private housing/quest data restricted to authorized interest
acceptance_tests: Inject loss/reorder/duplication/delay and verify same accepted end state
Two clients on opposite cell edges agree on encounter ownership
Reject stale authority epoch during handover/crash
Disconnect and resync without duplicate effect consequences

records.title: Save journaling and content migrations
inputs: Versioned snapshot and ordered journal tail
Approved migration chain and identifier aliases
Target content dependencies and legal fallback anchors
outputs: Preserved source save and blocked dependency reason
invariants: No renderer pointers or transient GPU state in saves
Migration retains item/entity identities or explicit reviewed aliases
Unsupported newer saves are preserved and refused clearly
acceptance_tests: Crash at every transaction boundary; one outcome or no commit
Replay old save after approved terrain edit; safe anchor and recorded relocation
Missing asset uses value/identity-preserving placeholder
Replay migration twice; second run no-op
failure_cases: Partial migration overwrites only valid backup

records.title: Cross-platform prototype evidence
inputs: Nominated device/OS/GPU/input matrix
Pinned engine/build/content revisions
Reviewed workload and provisional budgets
outputs: Pass/fail/blocked results by device and feature
invariants: No platform support claim from a bundle build or CPU test
Low quality preserves gameplay cues and legal access
Source fidelity and world performance are separate gates
acceptance_tests: Measure p50/p95/p99 CPU/GPU frame and streaming times with peak/resident memory
Test suspend/resume, storage-full, bandwidth restriction and thermal soak
Check selected input/accessibility modes and localized critical cues
Run unchanged source wrapper regressions and designated GPU parity matrix
failure_cases: Cold shader or IO stall exceeds reviewed budget
